summary: Standalone local modules or plugins can be made available everywhere through configured paths, or only to certain playbooks or roles through adjacent directories.
questions: Can I make a custom module available only to one playbook?
What are the options for loading standalone modules?

answer_card.title: Configured vs adjacent paths
answer_card.answer_md: Use **configured paths** to make a standalone module/plugin available to all playbooks and roles, or **adjacent paths** (next to a playbook or inside a role) to limit it to those.
